heading.en: Corps Wodrig in the Polish campaign

body.zh-Hant: 美國陸軍戰史稱，一個以其指揮官命名的臨時軍「沃德里希軍」編入第三集團軍，指揮自東普魯士南下華沙的兩個師。作戰計畫中，該軍與第一軍以一個裝甲師與四個步兵師向南朝華沙進攻。原文只寫姓氏，未載其名與生平。
body.en: The US Army history says a provisional corps named Wodrig after its commander was placed under Third Army and controlled two divisions moving south on Warsaw from East Prussia; it and I Corps were to attack toward Warsaw. The source gives only the surname.
